name: a-street-of-landmarks
title: A street of landmarks
summary: Four buildings from the gallery on one street, each at its real size and facing it: the Duomo di Milano, the Sainte-Chapelle and the Sagrada Família on the north side, the tea house across from them, and KESTREL, an invented ship, holding station above. Their real sites are far apart; this street is a what-if.

name: the-shed
title: The shed, the Samba and the Vespa
summary: A garden shed with a 1960s VW T1 Samba parked in front and a Vespa GS 150 beside its door; three constructs from the gallery, each whole and at real size.

name: villa-savoye-lived-in
title: The Villa Savoye, lived in
summary: The Villa Savoye (Poissy, 1931) with a life moved in: an Eames lounge chair, a Yamaha CFX, a Tompion year-going clock and two tables in the salon, a Braun SK 4, a Revox A77, a Leica M3, a Speedmaster and a Serum 2/61 on them, a Jackson by the piano, a Land Cruiser, a Samba and a Vespa under the pilotis, and Saturn as close as the Moon. Fifteen constructs from the gallery, each whole and at real size; the tables are designed for this world.
